title: "People Also Ask" Scraper
description: Scrape Google's 'People Also Ask' questions for any keyword. Find common user queries and generate content ideas that drive organic traffic to your blog.
enterKeywordDesc: Find questions people are asking about your topic
placeholder: e.g., web design, SEO, digital marketing
demoAlert: This tool demonstrates the interface. To scrape live "People Also Ask" data from Google, you would need to integrate with a third-party API service like SerpAPI, DataForSEO, or similar.
exampleDesc: Common "People Also Ask" questions for: Web Design
q1: What is web design and why is it important?
q2: How much does a website design cost?
q3: What are the key principles of good web design?
q4: What is the difference between web design and web development?
q5: How long does it take to design a website?
q6: What tools do web designers use?
q7: Is web design a good career?
q8: What skills do you need for web design?

how.title: How the People Also Ask Scraper Works
paragraphs: The page lays out the People Also Ask workflow: a keyword field, a search button and a results panel. The button is disabled and the list beside it is a fixed set of eight example questions about web design, so you can see how the questions are phrased and grouped without leaving the page.

Nothing here queries Google. Live People Also Ask results have to come from a search API such as SerpAPI or DataForSEO, as the notice above the button states. Read the example list as a reference for structure and wording, not as a current snapshot of what is in the search results.

useCases.title: When to Use This Tool
items: Seeing what a People Also Ask block contains before you connect a data source that returns one.
Drafting question-led sections for an article from the eight sample questions shown here.
Matching the style of question headings people actually type: short, specific and in plain language.
